title: Connect the GPS antenna only when de-energised
body_md: To connect the optional GPS antenna, Pro-finder must be de-energised. Disconnect the main wiring harness and plug the antenna connector into the four-pin socket. The main wiring harness can then be plugged back in.
prev_context: Section 1.5.1 ends on the previous page.
next_context: The requirement on the operating voltage after installation follows.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 12: equivalent in substance. Neither version explains the term “main wiring harness” although several operating steps depend on it (DSC-050).
